verdict.rationale: Cross-device task continuity is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions handoff or resuming work on another paired device. Snap groups (windows-docs-6) and tablet-to-laptop switching (windows-docs-19) are same-device features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can start a task on one device and finish it on another paired device
